Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Ultrathin LED-Integrated Table Lamp, 20"H, Pink
Colors: Pink
With a stunning contemporary design, this integrated LED lamp is the perfect task light when you want to add style to any table or room. An ultrathin body combines with a pink finish to create the ultimate modern look, so you do not need to sacrifice your decor to brighten your space. 10"W x 10"D x 20"H Metal shade and base in a pink finish Bring great light and style to any space with this sleek table lamp. LED integrated. Assemble in 15-30 minutes For indoor use only.
